title: Telling the time on a clock step by step
examples: How do I tell the time?

explain.say: Look at the clock on the board. It has 2 hands, a short hand and a long hand. The long hand points straight up to 12. The short hand points to 3. It is 3 o'clock.

draw.text: Telling the time on a clock step by step

explain.say: Now look at the 3D picture of a clock. You can see the hour hand, the minute hand and the second hand. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.

draw.text: Telling the time on a clock step by step

explain.say: The short hand tells the hour. The long hand tells the minutes. When the long hand points up to 12, it is o'clock. Here the short hand points to 7. What time is it?
Now the long hand points down to 6. It has gone half of the way round. That is half past. The short hand is halfway between 7 and 8. So it is half past 7.
Now the long hand points to 3. It has gone a quarter of the way round. That is quarter past. It is quarter past 7. Can you see the quarter of the clock?
Now the long hand points to 9. That is quarter to the next hour. It is quarter to 8. Today, look at a clock at home at bedtime.

faq.a: The short hand tells the hour. It moves only from one number to the next in a whole hour.
asks: Tell me about the short hand

faq.a: The long hand tells the minutes. It goes all the way round the clock once every hour.
asks: Tell me about the long hand

faq.a: Half past means thirty minutes after the hour. The long hand points down to 6. A teacher or grown-up can help you practise with a toy clock.
Quarter past means fifteen minutes after the hour. The long hand points to 3.
Quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour. The long hand points to 9.

facts: The minute hand goes all the way round a clock once every hour.
At half past, the minute hand points to 6 and the hour hand is halfway between two numbers.

quiz.say: It is 5 o'clock. Where does the long hand point?
quiz.show: 🕔 5 o'clock. Where does the long hand point?
quiz.why: At o'clock, the long hand points straight up to 12.

wrong.0: The short hand points to 5 at 5 o'clock.
wrong.1: The long hand points to 6 at half past.

quiz.say: Look at the long hand. It points to 3. Which time words match?
quiz.show: Long hand points to 3. Which words match?
quiz.why: The long hand on 3 has gone a quarter of the way round. That is quarter past.

wrong.0: At half past, the long hand points to 6.
wrong.2: At quarter to, the long hand points to 9.
